x.author: Aaron Levie
x.role: ceo @box - your business lives in content. unleash it with AI
x.summary: Aaron Levie 近期分享了关于技术与产品的最新动态，重点涉及技术路线、产品进展与一线实践思考。
x.translation:
The monetization potential of personal agents that are transacting on your behalf you is quite significant.

If you imagine agents that are perfectly capable of handling an arbitrarily complex task end to end, then eventually a substantial amount of commerce inevitably goes through them. 

You’ll start by slinging your daily simple and annoying tasks at the agent. Then as people get used to it, they’ll just start to throw more complex tasks at the agent, ultimately leading to even more spend through these systems than what they were doing before. If you can bring down the friction for commerce and services, then you end up spending even more. 

This thus creates a ton of opportunity for the agent providers (Muse, etc.), but also completely new opportunities to build the layer that the agents want to interact with (commerce, local, b2b services, etc.). Win/win for multiple layers.

AI agents will use software 100X more than people ever did. Even as interfaces begin to fade into the background as you primarily interact with agents, those agents still need many of the core primitives that people have used.

In fact, in many ways these core primitives become even more important when agents can take destructive actions in our systems or where the context they’re accessing with make or break the workflow. This will be true of where you house your CRM or ERP or structured or unstructured data platforms.

The platforms that can best act as the security layer and guardrails for agents, manage the data for agents and people, and orchestrate the business logic for workflows have a huge opportunity right now. This is true for brand new startups as well as existing platforms that can move fast enough.
x.recommendation: 作为 Aaron Levie 的一手动态，展示了一线 Builder 的最新思考与产品探索，具备较高的行业参考价值。

blogs.title: Claude in Chrome is generally available
blogs.summary: Claude Blog 发布了关于「Claude in Chrome is generally available 」的技术博文，详细阐述了其工程实践与前沿设计方案。
blogs.translation: Claude in Chrome is now generally available on every paid Claude plan. Claude can now also take actions autonomously in the browser, instead of needing approval for every one. A safety classifier validates each action before it’s performed to ensure it’s safe and matches your request. Many of the tools you use every day connect to Claude . But many others don’t, such as internal dashboards, legacy systems, and vendor portals. Claude in Chrome lets Claude access those. It can view the page you’re on and take actions like reading and typing text, clicking links, navigating between pages, and filling out forms, using your existing logins. We first announced Claude in Chrome as a pilot last year, so we could test it while also shoring up our defenses against prompt injection : malicious instru...

githubTrending.recommendation: 作为 Google 在 Agent 基础设施领域的重磅布局，Ax 今日激增超 2300 Star，标志着开发者对标准化 AI 编排框架的迫切需求，是 AI 工程化落地的必修课。

githubTrending.recommendation: 今日 Star 激增近千，反映了开发者对“Agent 编排与多端同步”需求的爆发。Orca 成功将复杂的 Agent 调度转化为开箱即用的生产力工具，是 AI 工程化落地的标杆项目。

githubTrending.title: AutoClip：基于AI驱动的自动化视频高光提取与智能剪辑工具
githubTrending.summary: AutoClip 是一款旨在解决长视频内容二次创作效率问题的开源工具。它通过集成先进的 AI 模型，能够自动识别视频中的精彩片段、关键动作或高能瞬间，并自动完成剪辑与导出。系统架构上，该项目深度整合了多模态分析技术，支持对视频流进行实时语义理解与特征提取，极大地降低了短视频创作者的剪辑门槛。其核心特性包括智能镜头分割、自动配乐对齐以及一键生成高光合集，非常适用于游戏录屏、直播切片及长视频内容精简等高频场景，是自动化内容生产流水线中的重要组件。
githubTrending.translation: AutoClip：一款由 AI 驱动的视频自动剪辑与高光时刻生成工具。
githubTrending.recommendation: 今日斩获近 600 Star，体现了 AI 视频自动化处理在内容创作领域的强劲需求。其工程化落地能力值得开发者借鉴，是探索多模态 AI 应用落地的极佳范例。

githubTrending.name: agent-native
githubTrending.title: BuilderIO/agent-native：构建原生 AI Agent 应用的开发框架
githubTrending.summary: Agent-native 是由 Builder.io 推出的创新框架，旨在解决当前 AI 应用开发中“代理逻辑与 UI 交互割裂”的痛点。该项目通过声明式架构，允许开发者将 AI Agent 的决策流直接嵌入原生应用逻辑中，实现从任务规划、工具调用到 UI 实时渲染的闭环。其核心优势在于极简的 API 设计与强大的跨平台兼容性，特别适合需要深度集成大模型能力、构建复杂交互式智能体（如自动化助手、智能工作流）的开发者。该框架通过抽象化 Agent 的状态管理，显著降低了构建高可用 AI 应用的工程门槛。
githubTrending.translation: 一个用于构建原生智能体（Agentic）应用的开发框架，支持将 AI 决策逻辑无缝集成至应用界面中。
githubTrending.recommendation: 今日激增 600+ Star，反映了开发者对‘Agent+原生应用’开发范式的强烈共鸣。对于希望快速落地 AI 智能体产品、提升交互体验的团队，该项目是目前最值得关注的工程化基石之一。

githubTrending.name: mvt
githubTrending.title: MVT：移动设备取证与潜在入侵迹象检测工具包
githubTrending.summary: MVT (Mobile Verification Toolkit) 是由 Amnesty International 开发的开源取证工具，旨在通过分析 iOS 和 Android 设备的备份文件、系统日志及文件系统镜像，识别潜在的恶意软件感染或非法监控痕迹。其架构基于 Python 编写，通过解析复杂的系统数据结构，自动化提取关键取证指标（IOCs），并将其与已知威胁情报进行比对。该工具广泛应用于安全研究人员、调查记者及隐私保护领域，是应对高级持续性威胁（APT）及移动端隐私审计的核心利器。
githubTrending.translation: MVT (移动验证工具包) 旨在协助对移动设备进行取证分析，以发现潜在的入侵迹象。
githubTrending.recommendation: 今日 Star 激增 441，反映了全球对移动端隐私安全与数字取证的高度关注。对于 AI 安全从业者而言，其自动化威胁检测逻辑与数据解析架构具有极高的参考价值。
